what: MCP tool parameters typed as z.number() will fail when LLMs send numbers as strings (common). Use z.coerce.number() instead for all numeric MCP tool parameters to auto-convert string→number. Fixed in src/memory/server.ts for id and limit params.
why: Claude sent id as string "19" instead of number 19, causing zod validation error. This is a known LLM behavior — always coerce MCP params.
